routes.name: Niger visa (from a Nigerien mission)
routes.summary: Foreign visitors need a passport with a Nigerien visa at the border unless a bilateral or community agreement exempts them. Apply at the Nigerien embassy or consulate in the country where you live.

other: Visa fee is set by each mission, so ask yours
The page is dated 2023, so confirm with your nearest Nigerien mission

steps: Contact the Nigerien mission in your country of residence
Submit the form in duplicate with photos and passport copy
documents: Passport and copy of data page
Visa application form completed and signed, in duplicate
Two recent 4x4 passport photos, no head covering
routes.processing: About 15 days per the Foreign Ministry page.

sources.label: Niger Foreign Ministry, entry into Niger

routes.name: Exceptional visa at the border
routes.summary: In exceptional cases, a visa can be granted at the entry point with the Interior Minister's authorization. It is for people coming from a country with no Nigerien mission.

other: You must live in a country with no Nigerien embassy or consulate
Needs approval through the Foreign Ministry, Presidency and Interior Ministry, plus a security check
After approval you finish formalities with the Direction de la Surveillance du Territoire

sources.label: Niger Foreign Ministry, entry into Niger

routes.name: Airport transit without a visa
routes.summary: Air travelers on a layover don't need a visa if they stay inside the airport limits.

other: You must stay within the airport during the layover

sources.label: Niger Foreign Ministry, entry into Niger

routes.name: ECOWAS free movement (status uncertain)
routes.summary: Niger left ECOWAS on 29 January 2025. ECOWAS said Nigerien citizens keep visa-free movement and residence in ECOWAS states until further notice. What ECOWAS citizens get in Niger isn't covered on the pages I could open.

other: Niger's own Foreign Ministry page does not name ECOWAS or list exempt countries
Check with a Nigerien mission before traveling
